tickets.scope: UC tables anomaly_rules, anomaly_reports (DDL) + Rule Evaluator Databricks job (cron 15min: load rules -> eval thresholds -> open/close incidents)
CRUD anomaly_rules, GET /anomaly-reports (list/filter), POST /internal/anomaly-reports (M2M JWT ingress from pipeline)
Anomaly Rules page (table, create/edit custom rule dialog, activate/deactivate)
Anomaly Reports page (table, filters, detail view, Jira link placeholder)

dependency_notes: Alerting Module (notification_channels, alert_configs, AlertingService, MailJet/Teams/Jira) is a separate follow-up spec (Spec B), not in scope here. POST /internal/anomaly-reports is called by the pipeline but has no notification side-effect yet in this spec.
prerequisites: P1 company anomaly rules spike: identify target metrics/thresholds per domain (pipeline, compute, cost, standard_check, storage, database) before /speckit.plan
Dedup policy decision: UNIQUE (rule_id, lz_id) vs multi-incident tolerance per rule
contracts_note: spec.md includes a Contracts section (AnomalyRule / AnomalyReport schema shape) referenced read-only by all 3 tickets to keep cross-domain context minimal.
summary: Détection d'anomalies DCM (rules + reports) - couche core avant le module alerting
